default_prompt:
GLOBAL RULE:
a] Always place each labeled item in the images on to its own separate line.
b] List all attributes on consecutive lines without empty line returns between them.
Example:
Band Name: AAAA
Album Title: BBBB
Catalog Number: CCCC

** SINGLE SPACED PRINTING **

1] Give me all the text and song names in the image
2] Separate the band name, album name, release date, label, catalogue number into its own sub group called "Release:"
	a] Capitalize the first letter of every word.
3] Separate the song titles into its own sub group called "Tracks:"
	a] Format tracks as [Side Letter][Track Number] - [Song Title] (e.g., A1 - Introduction, A2 - Chica Bonita, B1 - Dos Corazones).
	b] Convert Side 1 to A, Side 2 to B, Side 3 to C, etc.
	c] Do NOT include verbose prefixes like "Side 1 Track 1:" or duplicate leading track numbers like "1. Introduction".
	d] Capitalize the first letter of every word.
4] Separate any other data into its own sub group "Extra:"
	a] Capitalize the first letter of every word.
	b] List all Media attributes on consecutive lines without empty line returns between them.
5] Separate shell data into its own sub group "Media Description:"
	- For CASSETTE SHELL images: get the following: Shell Type/Style, Shell Texture, Timing Window, Shell Color, Ink Color, Binding (screws or sonic weld), Stamps
	- For CD images get Matrix, Runout, IFPI, etc.
	a] Capitalize the first letter of every word.
	b] List all Media attributes on consecutive lines without empty line returns between them.
6] Include all labels for the data. Do not include "Category names"
